_meta.source: Natural Earth 1:50m land minus glaciated_areas (public domain) minus 1:10m geography-regions named deserts
_meta.note: burnable = land AND NOT ice AND NOT named desert; Antarctica (lat ≤ -60) excluded. Named deserts only (NE geography regions) — unnamed barren/urban areas are NOT excluded; a full land-cover product (MODIS / ESA WorldCover) remains the fuller follow-up. Coarse grid, block-level accuracy.
